relationships.evidence_quote: Hu et al. (60) found that rTMS at 10 Hz could noticeably reduce inflammatory factors in NP rats, including TNF-α, lL-6, and IL-1β in anterior agranular insular (AId).

relationships.evidence_quote: Accordingly, rTMS alleviates NP conditions by suppressing nNOS overexpression in ipsilateral DRGs.

relationships.subject: rTMS
relationships.evidence_quote: Kim et al. (70)presented that rTMS applied on the motor cortex reduced the expression of Iba-1 and glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP) in spinal dorsal and ventral horns at the L4–L5 levels in NP rats (70).

key_findings: Review: rTMS (5-10 Hz over M1) lowers pro-inflammatory cytokines (TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, IL-6) and raises IL-10 and BDNF in cortical and subcortical tissue in neuropathic pain.
rTMS reduces glial markers Iba1/GFAP in spinal cord and nNOS in ipsilateral DRG.
